author: Animalogic
description:
Imagine being able to sleep while flying. Take a nap upside down. Or even use your bum as a pillow. It may sound like a dream, but these are all real ways animals sleep.

And these slumber skills aren’t just party tricks. They’re evolutionary life hacks, helping animals to survive in the unique environments they live in.    

So we’ve rounded up some of the most bizarre ways animals sleep. And get ready, because they’re about to blow your own sleep score out of the water.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
